official_identity: The current Indian Health Service Standing Rock Service Unit page identifies Fort Yates Hospital in Fort Yates, North Dakota as a 12-bed hospital and provides its facility location and services.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and city/state/ZIP agreement with the current IHS Fort Yates page support the federal scope disposition. The first-party page uses Standing Rock Avenue while CMS uses North River Road; this is retained as an address variant, not treated as a mismatch. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
